scope: native DOM with transcribed production card and list renderers, isolated simplified shell; not the full app or original exact-source CI fixture
initialMetric: synchronous shell/list construction before forced layout; opening wall time through toggle, excludes paint; do not compare opening as end-to-end latency
checks: 180/180 cycles: native toggle, hidden search via checkVisibility, form outside, independent ranking, search, edit, canceled archive, closed repaint, latest notes after reopen
testCorrection: getClientRects length is not a valid visibility test for closed details in Chromium; isolated test first failed then checkVisibility proved hidden. Playwright isVisible also returned false.
limitations: No iPhone, WebKit, full CSS, physical memory measurement or crash certification; synthetic fixture only.
